MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable fits my pattern of buying practical connections for devices I already own, although I would check the connections on my DVD player and television first.",
    "The external drive relates to my repeated camera and memory-card purchases because backing up photos could be useful, though 16TB may exceed my needs.",
    "The Fire TV Stick offers a plausible new use for my television, provided it supports the connections and services I need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers, displays, and smart plug assume I want voice control or home automation, but my purchases have addressed specific mounting, charging, storage, and connection needs.",
    "Buying GPS accessories does not mean I need a voice assistant in my car; those accessories help me position and connect equipment I already use.",
    "Owning a Fire 7 does not give me a reason to replace it with a larger tablet, and I have no current need for a new keyboard and mouse."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in many Amazon devices, even when they serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My purchases of electronics accessories seem to have been treated as a broad desire for more electronics, without enough attention to the problem each purchase solved."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy accessories that support equipment I already own, so compatibility and a clear practical use matter more than a shared brand.",
    "My camera, memory-card, card-reader, and tripod purchases point to ongoing photo-storage and equipment-support needs.",
    "An additional device needs to offer something I currently lack; a larger screen or voice control alone does not establish that need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and television interests but overread practical accessory purchases as a desire for smart devices and replacements."
}
